summary: Megan Holdings Ltd., a Malaysian foreign private issuer, filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing interim financial information, XBRL exhibits and related disclosures for the period ended June 30, 2026. The filing includes segment data, related-party balances and references to prior IPO-related share activity, but does not announce a transaction, tender, buyback, strategic review or forced leadership change. No price, stake, premium, advisor or board recommendation is stated. No special-situation terms are present.
